unsupported: Illinois Components serves the electronics manufacturing sector, handling all surface mount and through-hole devices, as well as the metals industry for spacers, stampings, screw-machine parts, and standoffs. Its customers are typically original equipment manufacturers and contract assemblers seeking to streamline production with reliable, standards-compliant packaging.

The company emphasizes rapid turnaround, quoting completion from inception to delivery in one week or less for custom solutions. It adheres to EIA taping standards and ESD procedures, and differentiates itself through custom pocket design, quick-turn programming, and a customer-centric approach that prioritizes precision and on-time delivery.
